import sys
import math
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    p = []
    index = 1
    for i in range(N):
        row = []
        for j in range(N):
            val = int(data[index])
            index += 1
            row.append(val / 100)
        p.append(row)

    current_state = {0: 1}
    for i in range(N):
        next_state = defaultdict(float)
        for b, sc in current_state.items():
            ones = [x for x in range(1 << N) if (b >> x) & 1]
            for e in range(1 << N):
                pr = 1.0
                for j in range(N):
                    if (e >> j) & 1:
                        pr *= p[i][j]
                    else:
                        pr *= 1 - p[i][j]
                nb = 0
                for x in ones:
                    for r in range(N):
                        if ((e >> r) & 1) and not ((x >> r) & 1):
                            nb |= 1 << r
                next_state[nb] += sc * pr
        current_state = next_state

    answer = 0.0
    for b, sc in current_state.items():
        if (b >> (N - 1)) & 1:
            answer += sc
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
